davidsonmarshall: Rafael Davidsonmars arrived on Day 4 as a replacement. The men in R-F2 had been fighting for 3 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world. Orders assigned Rafael Davidsonmars to work as a sniper. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

At the Hanging Bridge, Rafael Davidsonmars of the Concord and Cyril "Tin" Latsch of the Hegemony spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning. A letter from home reached Rafael Davidsonmars before dusk. Rafael Davidsonmars read it twice and slept a little easier.
